messages.setup_existing_installation: Connect to an existing Supabase installation. Preserve its invitations, guests and admin accounts.
messages.setup_new_target_intro: Choose Local or Cloud, install the current schema, then create the first administrator.
messages.setup_local_description: Supabase running on your computer or VM.
messages.setup_choose_target: Choose Local or Cloud before continuing.
messages.setup_cloud_install: Open its SQL Editor and run the complete downloaded installer once on the empty application schema.
messages.setup_start_local: Start your local Supabase stack. If the CLI already installed the current baseline, skip the SQL installation.
messages.setup_empty_schema_install: If the application schema is empty, open SQL Editor and run the complete downloaded installer once.
messages.setup_local_credentials: Use the API URL and public browser key printed by supabase status.
messages.setup_fresh_install_guard: Never run the fresh installer over an installed event. This wizard does not execute SQL or reset a database.
messages.setup_configuration_delivery: For GitHub Actions, set the repository variables RSVP_SUPABASE_URL and RSVP_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, then rerun the website deployment. For direct static hosting, download config.js and install it as js/config.js. Browser-only setup applies only to this browser.
messages.setup_server_configuration: Before testing the website, complete the server configuration below. Local installations use the local setup guide; cloud installations use the Studio guide.
messages.setup_cloud_functions: Deploy guest-gateway and admin-invitations from the same release, with platform Verify JWT OFF.
messages.setup_local_functions: Run both Edge Functions in your local stack with the site environment settings. Keep application validation enabled.
messages.setup_cloud_api_reason: Required for the website and Edge Function database calls.
messages.setup_cloud_exposure_reason: The installer grants only the access this application needs.
messages.setup_cloud_rls_reason: Keep this protection enabled. The installer also enables RLS and supplies the application policies.
messages.setup_cloud_schemas: Keep public in the Data API exposed schemas. Do not expose app_private.
messages.setup_cloud_options_intro: In the cloud project’s Security options, choose:
messages.setup_prerequisites_help: Complete these server steps first. The connection test checks the database and guest-gateway; it does not install or configure them.
messages.setup_hosting_order: GitHub Pages: the wizard configures this browser for testing. In step 4, save the public connection values as Actions variables and redeploy to configure the site for everyone.
messages.setup_pages_variables: In the website repository, open Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables. Add repository variables, not secrets.
messages.setup_pages_values: Set RSVP_SUPABASE_URL to the Project URL used in step 2 and RSVP_PUBLISHABLE_KEY to its public browser key. Enter values without JavaScript quotes.
messages.setup_pages_redeploy: Open Actions → Deploy RSVP → Run workflow, select the installed release and run it. Wait for the deployment to succeed.
messages.setup_pages_verify: Open the website in a private browser window to verify sign-in and Guest preview with the deployed configuration.
messages.setup_pages_generated_config: The workflow generates js/config.js. Uploading a downloaded config.js to the repository does not configure the Pages artifact. No configuration file upload is needed for this workflow.
messages.setup_direct_config: Download config.js and upload it as js/config.js in the website installation directory. Browser-only setup configures this browser, not other visitors.
messages.setup_local_site_settings: In the private local function environment file, set RSVP_SITE_ORIGIN to {origin} and RSVP_SITE_URL to {siteUrl}.
messages.food_interest_no_deadline_reply: Reply when no deadline is set
messages.food_interest_reply_help: Shown after a saved Yes in Collect interest. Use {rsvp_deadline:+5} for the RSVP deadline plus five calendar days in the event timezone. Blank text uses the fallback language, then English.
messages.food_interest_reply_default: Thank you! We’ll share more information about the food later.
messages.food_interest_reply_changed: Food interest reply changed; refresh before saving
messages.food_explanation_changed: Food explanation changed; refresh before saving
messages.placeholder_cursor_hint: Insert a placeholder at the cursor.
messages.deadline_plus_five: Five days after the RSVP deadline
messages.deadline_minus_two: Two days before the RSVP deadline
messages.deadline_offset_help: Change the offset from −366 to +366 calendar days. Without a deadline, the no-deadline reply is used.
messages.backup_password_recovery_warning: Keep this password safe. An encrypted backup cannot be recovered without it.
messages.backup_crypto_unavailable: Encryption requires HTTPS, Web Crypto and Web Workers. Unencrypted backups remain available.
messages.backup_crypto_busy: Another backup encryption operation is running.
messages.backup_kdf_failed: Backup key derivation could not complete. Try again on a device with more available memory.
messages.backup_file_password_hint: Enter this file’s backup password. It is not your administrator password.
messages.setup_auto_connect_your_cloud_supabase_p: Connect your cloud Supabase project. The temporary local companion handles privileged setup and forgets its credentials when finished.
messages.setup_auto_run_this_command_from_your_do: Run this command from your downloaded release on your own computer, then open the local address it prints.
messages.setup_auto_for_local_supabase_or_manual_: For Local Supabase or manual installation, use the existing setup guide.
messages.setup_auto_credentials_are_sent_only_to_: Credentials are sent only to this local companion and Supabase. They are not saved in browser storage or project files.
messages.setup_auto_use_a_dedicated_project_and_a: Use a dedicated project and a token with project, database, Auth configuration, Edge Function and secret read/write permissions.
messages.setup_auto_install_the_current_schema_or: Install the current schema, or add missing objects in a compatible partial installation. Existing rows are kept. Incompatible schemas and initialized applications are not overwritten.
messages.setup_auto_the_account_is_created_in_sup: The account is created in Supabase Authentication and confirmed directly. An existing account requires its current password.
messages.setup_auto_configure_rsvp_site_origin_an: Configure RSVP_SITE_ORIGIN and RSVP_SITE_URL for the website address. Supabase provides its platform credentials automatically. No third-party secret is required by the current application.
messages.setup_auto_deploy_and_verify_guest_gatew: Deploy and verify guest-gateway and admin-invitations from this release. Other functions are left alone. Existing conflicting JWT settings require review instead of being silently changed.
messages.setup_auto_configure_the_website_url_adm: Configure the website URL, administrator invitation redirect and Data API schemas. Keep the event unpublished and retain existing settings.
messages.setup_auto_check_schema_administrator_pe: Check schema, administrator permissions, secrets, function configuration and protected runtime responses before marking setup complete.
messages.setup_auto_the_application_is_initialize: The application is initialized. The event remains unpublished.
messages.setup_auto_download_the_public_browser_c: Download the public browser configuration for your hosting installation. Only the project URL and public key are included. For GitHub Pages, set the existing Actions connection variables and redeploy.
messages.setup_auto_continuing_configures_this_br: Continuing configures this browser for sign-in. Publish the public configuration to configure the website for other devices.
messages.setup_auto_setup_could_not_complete_this: Setup could not complete this step. Retry after checking the project connection and permissions.
messages.setup_auto_automatic_cloud_setup_with_th: Automatic cloud setup with the trusted local companion
messages.setup_auto_existing_installation_detecte: Existing installation detected. No project settings were changed.
messages.invitation_picture_help: Optional JPEG under 1.4 MB. Stored privately and copied into new delivery drafts. Existing drafts keep their picture.
messages.invitation_picture_share_help: Some apps accept only the picture or the text. If either is missing, use Share picture and Copy message, then paste the message in the app. Choose the recipient and check the invitation link before sending.
messages.test_invitation_sharing_help: Uses example names and a non-working example invitation link. No household code or delivery record is created. Choose yourself as the recipient.
messages.test_invitation_sharing_complete: Test share completed. Check the picture, text and example link in your app.
messages.test_invitation_preview_help: Uses example names and the landing-page preview link. No household code or delivery record is created. Choose yourself as the recipient.
messages.test_invitation_preview_complete: Test share completed. Check the picture, text and preview link in your app.
messages.album_use_the_button_beside_an_editor_to: Use the {…} button beside an editor to insert a supported placeholder.
messages.album_invitation_templates_and_food_inte: Invitation templates and Food Interest Reply
messages.album_set_an_rsvp_deadline_before_sharin: Set an RSVP deadline before sharing an invitation with deadline placeholders.
messages.album_other_wording_fields_keep_the_plac: Other wording fields keep the placeholders of their original phrase.
messages.album_add_pictures_to_the_album_first: Add pictures to the album first.
messages.album_shared_across_template_languages_a: Shared across template languages and channels.
messages.album_remove_this_album_picture_saved_te: Remove this album picture? Saved templates and messages keep their pictures.
messages.album_choose_whether_titles_appear_befor: Choose whether titles appear before guest names in each language. Titles are always hidden on small screens.
messages.album_the_picture_album_can_contain_up_t: The picture album can contain up to 12 pictures.
messages.album_guest_titles_changed_refresh_befor: Guest titles changed; refresh before saving
messages.album_picture_album_changed_refresh_befo: Picture album changed; refresh before saving
messages.session_invitations_changed_refresh: Session invitations changed; refresh before saving
messages.delivery_customization_help: Changes apply to this delivery only; the saved template stays unchanged.
messages.inline_fill_the_missing_placeholder_valu: Fill the missing placeholder values or choose a venue/session before sharing.
messages.inline_safety_backup_downloaded_store_it: Safety backup downloaded. Store it privately before replacing event data.
messages.inline_replaces_event_records_from_a_ful: Replaces event records from a Full backup on this installation. Current accounts, access and configuration stay unchanged. The event remains unpublished.

messages.inline_the_text_contains_an_unsupported_: The text contains an unsupported placeholder.

messages.guest_names_show_repeated_surname_beside: Show repeated surname beside each guest
messages.guest_names_hide_only_when_every_active_: Hide only when every active guest has the same non-empty surname as the household. Mixed surnames stay visible.
messages.guest_names_guest_name_preferences_chang: Guest name preferences changed; refresh before saving
messages.guest_names_household_last_name_is_too_l: Household last name is too long
messages.queued_choose_whether_titles_appear_befo: Choose whether titles appear before guest names in each language.
messages.queued_i_understand_application_data_wil: I understand application data will be replaced and other administrators disabled.
messages.queued_validate_before_restoring_full_an: Validate before restoring. Full and Partial restore require a clean destination. Wipe replaces application data from a Full backup, keeps your current administrator and destination configuration, and disables other administrators. The event remains unpublished.

Historical actors without a verified matching account are mapped to you, with original identities retained in the restore audit.

messages.layout_shared_across_invitation_template: Shared across invitation templates and services.
